name: travel-planner-agent
description: 基于 AI Agent 的旅游规划 Web 应用：以住宿为锚点生成每日行程，地图联动并支持到点打卡

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @travel/server" "npm run dev -w @travel/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @travel/server && npm run typecheck -w @travel/web
scripts.test: npm run check:ssrf && npm run check:runlock && npm run check:agent && npm run check:parser && npm run check:scheduler && npm run check:graph
scripts.build: npm run build -w @travel/server && npm run build -w @travel/web
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
